scope: Source-only performance-observability audit after one protected manual run;not FPS measurement or a bottleneck diagnosis

facts.finding: K80 constructs and checks its real present lease before show;fStatWaiting starts inside show and cannot account for the preceding lease/readiness retries. Existing printed wait statistic must not be presented as total K80 GPU wait.

Selected ZORN_IOS26 path calls CPU drawLayer and completes CPU stores before advancing pixel-copy counter. The non-ZORN scanout path is excluded. GPU rendering success does not imply direct panel scanout or cheap presentation.
Existing houji_fb_stats default0 gates IOLog reporting;current1022byte args omit it. Source counters alone do not produce serial stage timing.
Exact277 backboardd journal retains render-pass-split/memoryless-backed/shadowed-texture warnings. Their existence is not measured time attribution or Settings/LiquidGlass root-cause proof.

next: Prepare a separate offline candidate that exports bounded CPU timing for swap queue,lease wait/acquire,pixel copy/scale and completed presents through the existing checked serial path;reuse actual clock conversion and counters,keep all ownership and WDT/Recovery conditions. Then measure a fixed non-Settings workload;do not infer FPS from nine coarse snapshots or alter clocks first.
